cultivation.title: A smaller starting line
cultivation.summary: A new run starts small. The starting attributes were 1,000 Qi Affinity, 1,000 Comprehension, 1,000 Constitution and 400 each of Strength and Endurance, with SPD reading 10,000. They are now 1 Qi Affinity, 1 Comprehension, 100 of each physical attribute, and SPD reads 100%.

cultivation.title: The Laws, balanced
cultivation.summary: The new Laws are worth building a character around. Their stat effect was ×2.59 at 100%, a footnote beside Soul Transformation's numbers. It is now ×100: ×1.585 per 10%, so the ~20% a player arrives with is already ×2.5, 50% is ×10, 75% ×32.

jp-subs.title: Subtitle files
jp-subs.summary: Japanese `.srt`/`.vtt` in, English `.srt` out, in its own tab. This is how the project reaches video that is not on YouTube, and it costs no per-site work: a subtitle file is the same thing the interceptor already extracts — timed cues — so the two-pass pipeline is reused unchanged.

jp-subs.title: Quality of life
jp-subs.summary: Hide/show subtitles without discarding the translation. Glossary corrections applied to cached subtitles instantly, with no re-translation. Popup state read from durable storage instead of the worker's in-memory map, which MV3 wipes after ~30 s idle — that was why reopening the popup lost the button state.
